posts.summary: Opposes bill without private right of action provision
posts.quote: If the private right of action is gone, then the bill should be killed. It's useless.

posts.text:
I heard that first years at certain big law firms are starting at a $500k. That's more than twice what Senators and House members are paid, and they have to maintain two residences, one in costly DC.

You can't pay your public servants so little and expect good results.
